add.title: Add found devices
add.description: Devices from the last scan whose MAC is not in the list yet. The ones you tick are added to the list on the next page, where you can rename them before saving.

edit.title: MAC mappings
edit.description: One device per line: MAC;Name;Description (the description may be empty, but keep both semicolons). Saving reloads the integration.

error.invalid_mapping: Every line needs the form MAC;Name;Description with two semicolons.

abort.no_new_devices: Every device from the last scan is already in the list.
